title: Madad Abu Fazil
body:
Jane Ali khushbu e buturab
roshan jabee'n hashmi mahtaab
pani pe likhkha kate haath se
tune wafa o adab ka nisar
shahkar abu fazil
lashkar e ishq ke salaar abu fazil
shahkar abu fazil
lashkar e ishq ke salaar abu fazil
dildaar abu fazil
hamiye sayyad e ahraar abu fazil
sardaar abu fazil
saniye haider e qarrar abu fazil
Ya Abu fazil.. Ya Abu fazil..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ae rahat e qalb e ummul baneen
shere khuda ke jari janasheen
apni rawani pe aab e furat
karta raha dastaa'n dil nasheen
tehreer abu fazil
ayat e ishq ki tafseer abu fazil
tehreer abu fazil
ayat e ishq ki tafseer abu fazil
tat-heer abu fazil
Zahra ki khwab ki taseer abu fazil
dilgeer abu fazil
shah ke dard ki taseer abu fazil
Ya Abu fazil.. Ya Abu fazil..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ya saqiye behr e ishq o adab
teri pyaas ka mojiza hai ajab
sairab hota hai sehra e dil
rehmat ka banke barasta hai jab
abar abu fazil
chauda(14) sitaro mein qamar abu fazil
abar abu fazil
chauda(14) sitaro mein qamar abu fazil
badar abu fazil
mewa e dil noor e nazar abu fazil
faraj ki reh mein hamsafar abu fazil
Ya Abu fazil.. Ya Abu fazil..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Az quds taa hadd e parachinar
sehuniyat fikr hai ashkaar
dete hai tumko sadaa ghaib se
imam e zaman khaich kar zulfiqar
madad abu fazil
jahan e ghairat ki tu had abu fazil
madad abu fazil
jahan e ghairat ki tu had abu fazil
abd e samad abu fazil
hizzo ita'at ki sanad abu fazil
ahad abu fazil
waris e hamza ya asad abu fazil
Khoon e abu talib - Ya ghazi alamdaar
pisar e kulle ghalib - Mushkil mein madadgaar
bole siffin mein maula ali jaan
daste haider ki talwaar abu fazil
Ya Abu fazil.. Ya Abu fazil..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Lut jaein ghar baar zarr dedenge
katwaenge haath sar dedenge
deen e mohammad ke namoos par
apna yeh khoon e jigar de denge
hubdaar abu fazil
ashiq majnoon parastar abu fazil
hubdaar abu fazil
ashiq majnoon parastar abu fazil
is baar abu fazil
ran mein sabhi hai mukhtar abu fazil
azadar abu fazil
tere ashko'n ke kharidar abu fazil
Ya Abu fazil.. Ya Abu fazil..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Maa ki duao'n ki parwaaz mein
aahe sakina ki awaaz mein
humne suni teri khamoshiya'n
nehje balagha ke andaaz mein
aye jaan abu fazil
zainab ki god ke marjaan abu fazil
aye jaan abu fazil
zainab ki god ke marjaan abu fazil
sultan abu fazil
mehro wafa ke deewan abu fazil
qurbaan abu fazil
tere deewane muhibban abu fazil
Ya Abu fazil.. Ya Abu fazil..(3)
